tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary color. Filled buttons, outline-button borders, links, eyebrow labels, hero title start. White text on it passes 5.9:1.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand buttons and links.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the outline button. Soft highlight behind selected items. Never a text color.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Secondary accent. Page-title gradient end and the second line of the hero headline. Text on surface passes 8.9:1.

tokens.name: wine
tokens.usage: Large stat numbers (6M, 2X, 91%) in stat rows. Text on surface passes 7.6:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on surface and surface-muted. Also the footer bottom bar.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Subtitles, card meta lines (job title, state), footer links. Passes 8.6:1 on surface, 7.1:1 on surface-muted.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and card background.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Grey panel that holds testimonial cards. The footer band.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges where a shadow is not used.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and ink fills.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.sample: Take the first step toward your future
styles.usage: Hero headline only. brand on line 1, plum after.

styles.name: display-page
styles.usage: Page title, centered. brand to plum gradient.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers in stat rows, in wine.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section title inside a card or above a grid. ink.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Label under a stat, feature title, person name.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Explore the sectors that make up the tech field.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, footer links, list links. ink-muted or brand.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase category label above a card title, in brand.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; label-to-number gap in stats.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing, gutter between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between page sections.

tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs.
